body.name: Constrained six-unit non-extreme witness
body.construction: Let \(n=6\), \(m=3\), baseline balance scores be \((-6,-1,2,2,-8,7)\), and retain assignments whose absolute treated-minus-control score is at most \(4\). Then \(\Omega=\{\{1,2,6\},\{1,3,4\},\{2,5,6\},\{3,4,5\}\}\) with weights \(1/4\); take \(a=\{1,2,6\}\), unit \(1\) missing, and observed baseline outcomes on units \(2,\ldots,6\) equal to \((1,2,3,4,5)\).
